firm_data.firm_description: Cowan, DeBaets, Abrahams & Sheppard LLP provides legal counsel to leading media and entertainment clients, from individual creators, to corporations, associations and non-profit organizations. They understand their clients’ businesses and are committed to offering them individual attention that includes in-depth industry knowledge, as well as focused legal advice.
notable_facts: The firm has been providing legal counsel for more than 25 years.
The firm's attorneys represent clients across a broad range of practice areas in the entertainment, media, arts, and technology industries.

email.subject: AI for Cowan, DeBaets, Abrahams & Sheppard LLP, built for firms like yours
email.body:
Hi Kenneth,

With 25+ years advising leading media and entertainment clients, you've built something rare: a firm that combines deep industry knowledge with individual attention to creators and corporations alike. That requires precision at scale.

I lead business at Lucio, an AI platform built for law firms that face BigLaw demands with leaner teams. We recently raised $5M, and firms across 9 jurisdictions have chosen us over Harvey because we focus on the realities of smaller practices: precision, client trust, and efficiency.

Having completed successful pilots on the East Coast, we're now arriving in New York to meet regional firms. I'd be happy to stop by your office to share how, as ex-lawyers ourselves, we're helping similar firms compete with BigLaw.

Worth 20 minutes?

Vasu
Lucio
